notes: Fixture: fixtures/drifty-repo/ — a minimal repo with five deliberately planted problems. (1) CLAUDE.md documents `npm run test` and `npm run typecheck`; neither exists in package.json. (2) CLAUDE.md claims a `src/worker` package that does not exist. (3) src/api/AGENTS.md restates three rules verbatim from CLAUDE.md. (4) src/api/AGENTS.md references a `handlers/` dir that does not exist. (5) src/web has no AGENTS.md. A correct run finds all five by reading the docs against the tree. Note that (1) is the case a naive npm-only regex check misses half of, and (5) is a gap rather than a drifted claim — it is only visible by noticing src/web exists at all.

evals.name: finds-all-planted-drift
evals.prompt: our CLAUDE.md has kind of rotted - people keep adding to it and i dont think half of it is true anymore. can you go through this repo and tell me whats actually wrong with the agent docs? dont fix anything yet, i just want to see the damage first
evals.expected_output: A survey report naming all five planted problems, each citing the file it lives in. Nothing on disk is modified — the user explicitly asked for diagnosis only, and Phase 1 is read-only regardless.
assertions: Sized the agent docs by measuring them, not by estimating from a glance
Reports that npm run test is documented but absent from package.json
Reports that npm run typecheck is documented but absent from package.json
Reports src/worker as a ghost — documented but not present in the tree
Reports the three rules duplicated between CLAUDE.md and src/api/AGENTS.md
Reports the handlers/ directory referenced in src/api/AGENTS.md as nonexistent
Every finding cites the specific file it was found in
No file in the fixture repo was modified during the run

evals.name: tiers-the-plan-and-waits-for-approval
evals.prompt: audit the agent docs in this repo and then go ahead and clean them up for me
evals.expected_output: Even though the user said 'go ahead and clean them up', the skill surveys first and presents a tiered plan, stopping for approval before editing. Corrections (drifted claims, dead references) land in Tier 1; the missing src/web AGENTS.md is a Tier 2 or 3 item, not a Tier 1 correction.
assertions: Presented a survey report before proposing any edits
Proposed changes grouped into explicit tiers, cheapest first
Drifted command claims and the src/worker ghost are placed in Tier 1
Stopped and asked for approval rather than editing files immediately
No file in the fixture repo was modified before approval was requested
